title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Awesomemotive…
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Coming Soon Page, Under Construction & Maintenance Mode plugin by SeedProd, specifically in versions up to 6.20.12. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, leading to DOM-based XSS. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.1.
